# runcell

> TypeScript runtime for running AI agents in sandboxes with structured
> results, file outputs, persistent threads, and per-run token/cost usage.
> npm: `runcell`. Chat frontends (assistant-ui, AI SDK useChat) connect with
> zero glue via the UI Message Stream protocol.

## Credentials, the short version

- Default (omit `credentials`): reads env vars. Exact passthrough: any
  `*_API_KEY`, any `*_BASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN`.
  Provider variable = provider id upper-cased + `_API_KEY`
  (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` for the
  Vercel AI Gateway).
- `credentials: 'local'`: uses subscription logins from `~/.pi/agent`.
  The login (`npx pi`, then `/login`) is interactive with a browser
  sign-in. A HUMAN must run it once per machine; an AI agent cannot.
  Check `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` exists instead of launching the TUI.
- NEVER create or edit `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` by hand. Never commit it.
- If neither logins nor API keys exist, stop and ask the human. There is
  no credential an agent can generate.
- Production with shared refreshable credentials:
  `credentials: { type: 'shared' }` with `@runcell/postgres-credentials`.
